description: TypeScript 4.1+: `[K in keyof T as NewKey]` renames each output property while `K` still refers to the original key.
When the `as` clause resolves to `never`, the property is removed from the result.
Keeps only string keys, which template literal types and `Capitalize` require.

term: Mapping over a union of objects
description: `[Member in Union as Member['type']]` derives one property per union member, ideal for discriminated unions.
